integrity: Full finite search spaces, explicit circular witnesses, integer-only standalone verification, and independent direct checks at small orders are included. The review is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact optimality is established only for binary cyclic order 2 through 7 and only for inclusion of all indexed even-weight words; no higher-order optimum, complete maximizer census, or historical-priority certification is claimed. The institution-hosted full text of a relevant 2013 thesis was inaccessible.
title: Exact short cyclic covers of every even-parity binary window through order seven
